section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the descriptive information and data preparation for a study examining men (n=432) separated by sexual orientation: heterosexual men (n=301) and sexual minority men (n=131). The section reports that Cronbach's alphas were low for certain measures among sexual minority men, so some analyses were conducted only for heterosexual men. Missing data was present in 31.63% of participants, and multiple imputation with 100 imputations was applied to complete the dataset.
